root_cause: Rank-correlation DV computed over a constant-by-construction input vector, past a guard that tests RANK variance (double-argsort of a constant returns a 0..K-1 permutation with large std, so the guard never fires). Correct guard is on the INPUT vector (np.std(a)==0 or len(set(a))<2).

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-27 (failure_autopsy_sd081-spearman-degenerate-dv): CONFIRM non_contributory. The load-bearing recruitment DV (1 - rho(full, first)) is degenerate: 'first' is scored at world_seq[:, :1, :], the current state shared by all candidates, so it is constant by construction, and the _spearman guard tests RANK variance which cannot fire on a constant. Recruitment values are indistinguishable from the constant-vector null. The run's own candidate_score_range_non_degenerate precondition checks the 'full' vector's range, not 'first', so it could not catch this. Independent of (and deeper than) the familiarity_separation precondition failure the run self-routed on. MECH-163 UNWEAKENED -- the run tested nothing about the claim. Lineage already repaired by V3-EXQ-786b (ree-v3 2f43287: HABIT_DEPTH=2 so 'first'/habit vector spans >=2 world-states, plus an input-range readiness gate on both score vectors). Instrument defect, NOT substrate_ceiling -- does not count toward the MECH-163 re-derive brake (R3).

re_derive_brake.reason_not_fired: recommended category is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling; under convention R3 only substrate_ceiling counts, so this run adds 0 to the MECH-163 ceiling tally

learning_extracted: A degeneracy guard must test the INPUT vector, not a post-argsort rank vector -- rank variance of a constant input is maximal, not zero.

A run's own non-degeneracy precondition can check the WRONG vector: 786 checked 'full' range while the DV's second argument 'first' was the constant one. Non-degeneracy checks must cover EVERY input the DV consumes.
The 786 lineage fix (786b) closes the degenerate path by construction (depth-2) plus an explicit input-range gate; its residual unfireable rank-variance guard should adopt the input-vector form.

The rho_drive_vs_reef per-arm diagnostic is degenerate on the 64/378 arms reporting mean_reef_fraction==0.0 (flat_in_reef all-zero -> constant vector past a rank-variance guard that cannot fire), producing values up to |0.74| that are deterministic tie-break artifacts (identical values recur across siblings: 0.74072 in 543g/h/i/j, 0.0088 in 543h/i/j/k/l). learning_extracted: A degenerate metric can be confined to a non-load-bearing diagnostic (543) or be the load-bearing DV (786). Adjudication must trace whether the degenerate quantity feeds a gate before choosing between 'annotate' and 'non_contributory'.
